verdict.rationale: Operating a sales-tax SaaS through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents a conventional API with key authentication, language SDKs, platform integrations and AutoFile. Nothing shows a natural-language interface, AI assistant or agent integration, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
